entities.title: Online rooms belong to the games hub
entities.summary: The Durable Object that held online rooms moved to the games hub; Shatterbelt only connects to it.
entities.context: Rally, Shatterbelt and Hivestorm all play online, and players meet in one multiplayer lobby.
entities.decision: The relay is a Durable Object per match in the games hub, at /games/multiplayer/match/{ID}. Shatterbelt's Worker deletes its old Room class, and both migration entries are kept.
entities.rationale: One lobby and one relay for every game; Cloudflare applies migrations in order, so removing the first entry would break the deploy.

entities.title: Keep answering the first address
entities.summary: The Worker keeps the route icelander.net/retro-games/shatterbelt* and redirects it to the game's current address.
entities.context: Shatterbelt first lived at icelander.net/retro-games/shatterbelt and moved to icelander.net/games/retro/shatterbelt.
entities.decision: The Worker is routed at both addresses and answers every path under the old one with a 308 to the same path under the new one.
entities.rationale: Old links and bookmarks keep working, and a 308 keeps the method.
